classes.name: Wahl des Bundespräsidenten durch die Bundesversammlung
classes.name_en: Election of the Federal President by the Federal Convention
classes.note: Counted per ballot (Wahlgang): a third ballot is held when no candidate wins an absolute majority in the first two. The Federal Convention is the Bundestag plus an equal number of members chosen by the Landtage.

cadence.runoff_rule: Absolute majority in the first two ballots; a plurality elects in the third (Art. 54 Abs. 6 GG).
cadence.vacancy_rule: On early end of term the Convention meets within 30 days (Art. 54 Abs. 4 GG), as in 2010 and 2012.

classes.name: Wahl des Bundeskanzlers durch den Bundestag
classes.name_en: Election of the Federal Chancellor by the Bundestag
classes.note: Secret ballot of the Bundestag on the Federal President's proposal (Art. 63 GG), with further ballots when the first fails, and constructive votes of no confidence (Art. 67 GG, 1972 and 1982). The Bundestag's plenary records and Datenhandbuch give each ballot's yes, no, and abstention counts.

classes.name: Volksabstimmungen zur Neugliederung des Bundesgebietes
classes.name_en: Territorial referendums on the boundaries of the Länder
classes.note: Held under Art. 29 and 118 GG: the Südweststaat vote of 9 December 1951 that formed Baden-Württemberg, the Baden vote of 7 June 1970, the Oldenburg and Schaumburg-Lippe votes of 19 January 1975, and the Berlin–Brandenburg merger vote of 5 May 1996. The Saar statute referendum of 23 October 1955 preceded the Saar's accession.

classes.name: Sozialversicherungswahlen (Sozialwahl)
classes.note: Every six years (2011, 2017, 2023, next 2029) the insured and employers elect the boards (Vertreterversammlung, Verwaltungsrat) of the pension, health, and accident insurance carriers; most carriers settle by agreed lists without a vote (Friedenswahl), and a few hold postal ballots (Urwahl). Run by each carrier's election committee under the Federal Commissioner for Social Insurance Elections, who publishes a final report.
classes.disposition_reason: Functional self-government of social insurance carriers with lists of unions and employer and insured-persons' associations, like chamber and workplace votes; no territorial office and no party lists.

The single-list votes of 1933 (November), 1936, and 1938 are not free elections and are not listed. Tables 17 and 18 of the Federal Returning Officer's compendium give dates, electorate, votes, and seats.

classes.name: Wahlen zur Volkskammer der DDR
classes.note: From 1950 to 1986 a single list of the National Front, with no choice between candidates; the free election of 18 March 1990 used list proportional representation in 15 constituencies (the 14 Bezirke and East Berlin) without a threshold, electing 400 members.

classes.name: Wahlen zu den örtlichen Volksvertretungen der DDR
classes.name_en: GDR local assembly elections (Bezirkstage, Kreistage, city and municipal assemblies)
classes.note: Single lists of the National Front from 1950 to 1989 (the falsified count of 7 May 1989 among them); the free Kommunalwahlen of 6 May 1990 elected the Kreistage, city assemblies, and Gemeindevertretungen that carried over into the new Länder. The Bezirkstage were not re-elected in 1990 and ended with the Länder in October 1990. The Soviet zone's Gemeinde and Kreistag elections of September and October 1946 precede the GDR.

classes.name: Volksbefragungen und Volksentscheide der DDR
classes.note: The Volksbefragung of 3 to 6 June 1951 against remilitarization and the constitutional Volksentscheid of 6 April 1968; neither offered a free choice.

classes.name: Wahlen der Gemeinderäte, Stadträte, Gemeindevertretungen und Stadtverordnetenversammlungen
classes.note: Every municipality elects its council (Gemeinderat, Stadtrat, Gemeindevertretung, Stadtverordnetenversammlung, Rat) by list proportional representation, in Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate, and other Länder with panachage and cumulation; EU citizens vote (Art. 28 GG). Each Land fixes its own term and day: five years everywhere except Bavaria (six years, March) and Bremen (four years, with the Bürgerschaft). Berlin and Hamburg have no municipal council; their parliaments act as both. Cadence rows from Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, Saxony-Anhalt, Schleswig-Holstein, and Thuringia cite results publications or statute excerpts, not the full statute text.

access.evidence: The Kommunalwahlen page offers XLSX results by Gemeinde, including Verbandsgemeindeversammlungen.

classes.name: Kreistagswahlen
classes.note: All 294 Landkreise elect a Kreistag on the Land's local election day, for the same term as the municipal councils (six years in Bavaria, five elsewhere); the 106 kreisfreie Städte have no Kreistag. Region Hannover, the Städteregion Aachen, and the Regionalverband Saarbrücken elect their assemblies the same way.

classes.name: Direktwahl der Bürgermeister und Oberbürgermeister
classes.note: Every Land elects its full-time mayors directly, with a runoff (a plurality second ballot in Saxony); terms run from five years (North Rhine-Westphalia) to ten, and most mayoral elections fall on their own dates rather than the general local election day. Honorary mayors are elected directly in some Länder and by the council in others. Bremen's and Bremerhaven's mayors are chosen by their assemblies.

cadence.runoff_rule: Stichwahl between the top two on the second to fourth Sunday after the first ballot (GemO § 45 Abs. 2).
Stichwahl between the top two on the second Sunday after the first ballot (GLKrWG Art. 46).
Runoff two weeks after the first ballot.
Stichwahl between the top two on the second Sunday after the first ballot.
A second ballot (zweiter Wahlgang) open to new candidates, decided by plurality.
Stichwahl two weeks after the first ballot.

classes.name: Direktwahl der Landräte
classes.note: Landräte are elected directly in Bavaria, Hesse, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Lower Saxony, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt, and Thuringia; in Baden-Württemberg, Brandenburg, and Schleswig-Holstein the Kreistag chooses them.

cadence.runoff_rule: Stichwahl between the top two on the second Sunday after the first ballot (GLKrWG Art. 46).
Runoff two weeks after the first ballot.
Stichwahl two weeks after the first ballot.
Stichwahl between the top two on the second Sunday after the first ballot.

classes.name: Wahlen zu den Bezirksverordnetenversammlungen
classes.note: Held with every Abgeordnetenhaus election (including the full repeat of 12 February 2023); EU citizens and 16-year-olds vote. Each of the 12 assemblies has 55 members.

classes.name: Wahlen zu den Bezirksversammlungen
classes.note: Held with the Bürgerschaft until 2011 and with the European election since 2014.

classes.name: Bezirkswahlen in Bayern
classes.note: The seven Bezirkstage are elected for five years together with the Landtag, by Stimmkreis with first and second votes like the Landtag.

classes.name: Wahlen der Regionalversammlung Stuttgart, der Verbandsversammlung des Regionalverbands Ruhr und des Bezirkstags Pfalz
classes.note: Three regional bodies above the Kreise elect their assemblies directly with the local elections: the Verband Region Stuttgart since 1994 (92 members in 2024), the Bezirksverband Pfalz's Bezirkstag, and the Regionalverband Ruhr since 13 September 2020. The Regionalversammlung of the Regionalverband Saarbrücken, Region Hannover's Regionsversammlung, and the Städteregionstag Aachen count with the Kreistage.

classes.name: Wahlen der Verbandsgemeinderäte, Samtgemeinderäte und Verbandsgemeindeversammlungen
classes.note: Of the 1,203 Gemeindeverbände, only the Verbandsgemeinden of Rhineland-Palatinate and Saxony-Anhalt, the Samtgemeinden of Lower Saxony, and Brandenburg's Verbandsgemeinden (since 2024) elect a council directly, with the local elections, and the first three also elect a Bürgermeister directly; Ämter, Verwaltungsgemeinschaften, and Verwaltungsverbände are run by delegates of their member municipalities.

classes.name: Wahl der Ministerpräsidenten, Regierenden Bürgermeister und Präsidenten des Senats durch die Landtage
classes.name_en: Election of state premiers by the Landtage
classes.note: Each Landtag elects the head of the Land government by secret ballot, with further ballots when the first fails (for example Hesse 2008 and Thuringia 2020 and 2024); the Landtag's plenary records give each ballot's counts.

classes.name: Wahlen der Ortschaftsräte, Ortsbeiräte, Ortsräte, Bezirksvertretungen und Beiräte
classes.note: Elected with the municipal councils where the municipality's main statute creates them: Ortschaftsräte (BW, SN, ST, TH), Ortsbeiräte (HE, BB, MV, RP, SH), Ortsräte and Stadtbezirksräte (NI, SL), Bezirksvertretungen in NRW's kreisfreie Städte, Munich's Bezirksausschüsse, and Bremen's 22 Beiräte (directly elected with the Bürgerschaft since 1991). No national register counts the units.

classes.name: Direktwahl der Ortsvorsteher und Ortsbürgermeister
classes.note: Directly elected Ortsvorsteher in Rhineland-Palatinate's Ortsbezirke and Ortsteilbürgermeister in Thuringia; elsewhere the Ortschaftsrat or Ortsbeirat chooses its chair.

dates.note: Volksentscheid in the Land Saxony on the expropriation of Nazi and war criminals' property.

classes.name: Volksentscheide und Volksabstimmungen in den Ländern
classes.note: Constitutional referendums and Volksentscheide after a Volksbegehren in every Land, from Saxony's expropriation vote of 30 June 1946 and the 1946 to 1947 votes on the first Land constitutions; Bavaria, Berlin, and Hamburg hold most. Results are published by each Land's returning officer and statistics office; no official compilation lists them all.

classes.name: Bürgerentscheide in Gemeinden, Kreisen und Bezirken
classes.note: Allowed in every Land's municipal code (for example Bavaria's GO Art. 18a and Baden-Württemberg's GemO § 21) and in Berlin's and Hamburg's boroughs; results stay with each municipality, and no Land office keeps a full list.

classes.name: Wahlen der Ausländerbeiräte, Integrationsräte und Beiräte für Migration und Integration
classes.note: Statutory advisory councils elected by foreign residents: Hesse's Ausländerbeiräte (with the Kommunalwahl, last 15 March 2026), North Rhine-Westphalia's Integrationsräte (with the Kommunalwahl), and Rhineland-Palatinate's Beiräte für Migration und Integration, plus optional councils elsewhere.

classes.name: Kammer-, Betriebsrats-, Personalrats- und Hochschulwahlen
classes.disposition_reason: Workplace and professional-chamber votes (IHK, Handwerkskammern, medical and legal chambers, works and staff councils, university bodies) run by the bodies themselves for their members, not by the electoral authorities for a territorial electorate.

classes.name: Kirchenwahlen und parteiinterne Abstimmungen
classes.disposition_reason: Private and religious bodies: parish council elections of the churches and party member ballots and primaries (Mitgliederentscheide), which no public authority runs or certifies.

classes.name: Jugendgemeinderäte und Seniorenbeiräte
classes.disposition_reason: Optional advisory bodies set up by individual municipalities, elected under local rules without an electoral authority or published official returns.
